passages.text: Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants, and he cried out, “Send everyone away from me!” So none of them were with Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was a ruler in Egypt.
Joseph’s brothers stood before him.
Joseph could not control his emotions any longer.
Joseph had many attendants with him.
Joseph shouted, “Send everyone away from me!”
All the attendants left the room.
No one stayed with Joseph.
Joseph was alone with his brothers.
Joseph revealed himself to his brothers.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ יָכֹ֨ל יוֹסֵ֜ף לְהִתְאַפֵּ֗ק לְכֹ֤ל הַנִּצָּבִים֙ עָלָ֔יו וַיִּקְרָ֕א הוֹצִ֥יאוּ כָל־ אִ֖ישׁ מֵעָלָ֑י וְלֹא־ עָ֤מַד אִישׁ֙ אִתּ֔וֹ בְּהִתְוַדַּ֥ע יוֹסֵ֖ף אֶל־ אֶחָֽיו׃

passages.text: But he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh’s household soon heard of it.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was a ruler in Egypt.
Joseph began to weep.
He cried out with a loud voice.
The Egyptians heard Joseph crying.
Pharaoh’s household also heard about Joseph’s weeping.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֶת־ קֹל֖וֹ בִּבְכִ֑י וַיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע בֵּ֥ית פַּרְעֹֽה׃

passages.text: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Is my father still alive?” But they were unable to answer him, because they were terrified in his presence.
passages.sermon:
Joseph stood before his brothers.
Joseph revealed his identity.
Joseph said, “I am Joseph.”
Joseph asked, “Is my father still alive?”
His brothers could not answer him.
His brothers felt afraid of Joseph.
His brothers were terrified in his presence.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹסֵ֤ף אֶל־ אֶחָיו֙ אֲנִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף הַע֥וֹד אָבִ֖י חָ֑י וְלֹֽא־ יָכְל֤וּ אֶחָיו֙ לַעֲנ֣וֹת אֹת֔וֹ כִּ֥י נִבְהֲל֖וּ מִפָּנָֽיו׃

passages.text: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “Please come near me.” And they did so. “I am Joseph, your brother,” he said, “the one you sold into Egypt!
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the son of Jacob.
Joseph was the brother of the men standing before him.
Joseph had been sold by his brothers into Egypt.
Joseph spoke to his brothers.
Joseph said, “Please come near me.”
His brothers came near to him.
Joseph said, “I am Joseph, your brother.”
Joseph said, “You sold me into Egypt.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹסֵ֧ף אֶל־ אֶחָ֛יו גְּשׁוּ־ נָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וַיִּגָּ֑שׁוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֲנִי֙ יוֹסֵ֣ף אֲחִיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ מְכַרְתֶּ֥ם אֹתִ֖י מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃

passages.text: And now, do not be distressed or angry with yourselves that you sold me into this place, because it was to save lives that God sent me before you.
passages.sermon:
Joseph spoke to his brothers.
Joseph was the brother they had sold into Egypt.
Joseph said, “Do not be distressed.”
Joseph said, “Do not be angry with yourselves.”
Joseph said this because his brothers had sold him into Egypt.
Joseph explained, “God sent me ahead of you.”
God sent Joseph to Egypt to save lives.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀ אַל־ תֵּעָ֣צְב֗וּ וְאַל־ יִ֙חַר֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ מְכַרְתֶּ֥ם אֹתִ֖י הֵ֑נָּה כִּ֣י לְמִֽחְיָ֔ה שְׁלָחַ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים לִפְנֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: For the famine has covered the land these two years, and there will be five more years without plowing or harvesting.
passages.sermon:
Joseph spoke to his brothers in Egypt.
Joseph explained the situation in the land.
A famine has lasted for two years.
The famine covers the whole land.
There will be five more years of famine.
No one will plow the fields during these years.
No one will harvest crops during these years.
passages.original: כִּי־ זֶ֛ה שְׁנָתַ֥יִם הָרָעָ֖ב בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעוֹד֙ חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין־ חָרִ֖ישׁ וְקָצִּֽיר׃

passages.text: God sent me before you to preserve you as a remnant on the earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
passages.sermon:
God sent me ahead of you.
God did this to keep you alive.
God wanted to preserve you as a remnant on the earth.
God wanted to save your lives by a great deliverance.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהִים֙ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם לָשׂ֥וּם לָכֶ֛ם שְׁאֵרִ֖ית בָּאָ֑רֶץ וּלְהַחֲי֣וֹת לָכֶ֔ם לִפְלֵיטָ֖ה גְּדֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: Therefore it was not you who sent me here, but God, who has made me a father to Pharaoh—lord of all his household and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Joseph spoke to his brothers.
Joseph said, "You did not send me here.
God sent me here.
God made me a father to Pharaoh.
God made me lord over all Pharaoh’s household.
God made me ruler over all the land of Egypt."
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה לֹֽא־ אַתֶּ֞ם שְׁלַחְתֶּ֤ם אֹתִי֙ הֵ֔נָּה כִּ֖י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיְשִׂימֵ֨נִֽי לְאָ֜ב לְפַרְעֹ֗ה וּלְאָדוֹן֙ לְכָל־ בֵּית֔וֹ וּמֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Now return quickly to my father and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me without delay.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the son of Jacob.
God made Joseph lord over all Egypt.
Joseph spoke to his brothers.
Joseph told them to hurry and go to their father.
Joseph told them to say this to their father.
“Your son Joseph says: God has made me lord of all Egypt.”
Joseph told his father to come down to him without delay.
passages.original: מַהֲרוּ֮ וַעֲל֣וּ אֶל־ אָבִי֒ וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֣ם אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ בִּנְךָ֣ יוֹסֵ֔ף שָׂמַ֧נִי אֱלֹהִ֛ים לְאָד֖וֹן לְכָל־ מִצְרָ֑יִם רְדָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י אַֽל־ תַּעֲמֹֽד׃

passages.text: You shall settle in the land of Goshen and be near me—you and your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and everything you own.
passages.sermon:
Joseph spoke to his family.
Joseph was ruler in Egypt.
Joseph said, “You will live in the land of Goshen.
You will be close to me.
Your children will be with you.
Your grandchildren will be with you.
Your flocks will be with you.
Your herds will be with you.
Everything you own will be with you.”
passages.original: וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֣ בְאֶֽרֶץ־ גֹּ֗שֶׁן וְהָיִ֤יתָ קָרוֹב֙ אֵלַ֔י אַתָּ֕ה וּבָנֶ֖יךָ וּבְנֵ֣י בָנֶ֑יךָ וְצֹאנְךָ֥ וּבְקָרְךָ֖ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: And there I will provide for you, because there will be five more years of famine. Otherwise, you and your household and everything you own will come to destitution.’
passages.sermon:
Joseph spoke to his brothers.
Joseph was the son of Jacob.
God made Joseph ruler over all Egypt.
Joseph said, “I will provide for you there.”
There will be five more years of famine.
If I do not provide for you, you will lose everything.
You, your household, and all you own will become destitute.
passages.original: וְכִלְכַּלְתִּ֤י אֹֽתְךָ֙ שָׁ֔ם כִּי־ ע֛וֹד חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים רָעָ֑ב פֶּן־ תִּוָּרֵ֛שׁ אַתָּ֥ה וּבֵֽיתְךָ֖ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Behold! You and my brother Benjamin can see that I, Joseph, am the one speaking with you.
passages.sermon:
Joseph is speaking to his brothers.
Joseph is the ruler in Egypt.
Joseph says, “Look with your own eyes.
You see me here.
My brother Benjamin also sees me.
I am Joseph.
I am the one speaking to you.”
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֤ה עֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ רֹא֔וֹת וְעֵינֵ֖י אָחִ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ין כִּי־ פִ֖י הַֽמְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Tell my father about all my splendor in Egypt and everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly.”
passages.sermon:
Joseph spoke to his brothers.
Joseph had become a ruler in Egypt.
Joseph had great honor and splendor in Egypt.
Joseph told his brothers to tell their father about his splendor in Egypt.
Joseph told his brothers to tell their father about everything they had seen in Egypt.
Joseph told his brothers to bring their father to Egypt quickly.
passages.original: וְהִגַּדְתֶּ֣ם לְאָבִ֗י אֶת־ כָּל־ כְּבוֹדִי֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רְאִיתֶ֑ם וּמִֽהַרְתֶּ֛ם וְהוֹרַדְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ אָבִ֖י הֵֽנָּה׃

passages.text: Then Joseph threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin wept as they embraced.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the ruler in Egypt.
Joseph saw his brother Benjamin.
Joseph threw his arms around Benjamin’s neck.
Joseph wept.
Benjamin also wept.
Benjamin wept on Joseph’s neck.
passages.original: וַיִּפֹּ֛ל עַל־ צַוְּארֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן־ אָחִ֖יו וַיֵּ֑בְךְּ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן בָּכָ֖ה עַל־ צַוָּארָֽיו׃

passages.text: Joseph kissed each of his brothers as he wept over them. And afterward his brothers talked with him.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the ruler in Egypt.
Joseph had many brothers.
Joseph kissed each brother.
Joseph wept over each brother.
After this, Joseph’s brothers spoke with him.
passages.original: וַיְנַשֵּׁ֥ק לְכָל־ אֶחָ֖יו וַיֵּ֣בְךְּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְאַ֣חֲרֵי כֵ֔ן דִּבְּר֥וּ אֶחָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: When the news reached Pharaoh’s house that Joseph’s brothers had come, Pharaoh and his servants were pleased.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was a ruler in Egypt.
Joseph had brothers.
Joseph’s brothers came to Egypt.
People told Pharaoh that Joseph’s brothers had arrived.
Pharaoh heard this news in his house.
Pharaoh was pleased.
Pharaoh’s servants were also pleased.
passages.original: וְהַקֹּ֣ל נִשְׁמַ֗ע בֵּ֤ית פַּרְעֹה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בָּ֖אוּ אֲחֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיִּיטַב֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וּבְעֵינֵ֖י עֲבָדָֽיו׃

passages.text: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do as follows: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the ruler of Egypt.
Joseph was a Hebrew who served Pharaoh.
Pharaoh spoke to Joseph.
Pharaoh gave Joseph instructions for his brothers.
Pharaoh said, “Tell your brothers this.
Do this.
Load your animals.
Go.
Return to the land of Canaan.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף אֱמֹ֥ר אֶל־ אַחֶ֖יךָ זֹ֣את עֲשׂ֑וּ טַֽעֲנוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּעִ֣ירְכֶ֔ם וּלְכוּ־ בֹ֖אוּ אַ֥רְצָה כְּנָֽעַן׃

passages.text: Then bring your father and your families and return to me. I will give you the best of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat from the fat of the land.’
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh ruled Egypt.
Pharaoh spoke to Joseph.
Pharaoh told Joseph to bring his father.
Pharaoh told Joseph to bring his brothers' families.
Pharaoh told them to come to him in Egypt.
Pharaoh promised to give them the best part of Egypt.
Pharaoh said they would eat the richest food in the land.
passages.original: וּקְח֧וּ אֶת־ אֲבִיכֶ֛ם וְאֶת־ בָּתֵּיכֶ֖ם וּבֹ֣אוּ אֵלָ֑י וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה לָכֶ֗ם אֶת־ טוּב֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְאִכְל֖וּ אֶת־ חֵ֥לֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: You are also directed to tell them: ‘Take wagons from the land of Egypt for your young children and your wives, and bring your father and come back.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh spoke to Joseph.
Pharaoh gave Joseph instructions for his brothers.
Pharaoh told Joseph to tell his brothers what to do.
Pharaoh said, “Take wagons from Egypt.
Use these wagons for your children.
Use these wagons for your wives.
Bring your father with you.
Return here to Egypt.”
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֥ה צֻוֵּ֖יתָה זֹ֣את עֲשׂ֑וּ קְחוּ־ לָכֶם֩ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם עֲגָל֗וֹת לְטַפְּכֶם֙ וְלִנְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם וּנְשָׂאתֶ֥ם אֶת־ אֲבִיכֶ֖ם וּבָאתֶֽם׃

passages.text: But pay no regard to your belongings, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.’ ”
passages.sermon: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph’s brothers.\r\nPharaoh told them not to worry about their belongings.\r\nPharaoh said the best of all the land of Egypt belonged to them.
passages.original: וְעֵ֣ינְכֶ֔ם אַל־ תָּחֹ֖ס עַל־ כְּלֵיכֶ֑ם כִּי־ ט֛וּב כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לָכֶ֥ם הֽוּא׃

passages.text: So the sons of Israel did as they were told. Joseph gave them wagons as Pharaoh had instructed, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Israel obeyed the instructions.
Joseph gave the sons of Israel wagons.
Pharaoh had commanded Joseph to do this.
Joseph also gave the sons of Israel food and supplies for their journey.
passages.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵן֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֥ם יוֹסֵ֛ף עֲגָל֖וֹת עַל־ פִּ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֥ן לָהֶ֛ם צֵדָ֖ה לַדָּֽרֶךְ׃

passages.text: He gave new garments to each of them, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the ruler in Egypt.
Joseph gave gifts to his brothers.
Joseph gave each brother new clothes.
Joseph gave Benjamin special gifts.
Joseph gave Benjamin three hundred shekels of silver.
Joseph gave Benjamin five sets of clothes.
passages.original: לְכֻלָּ֥ם נָתַ֛ן לָאִ֖ישׁ חֲלִפ֣וֹת שְׂמָלֹ֑ת וּלְבִנְיָמִ֤ן נָתַן֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת כֶּ֔סֶף וְחָמֵ֖שׁ חֲלִפֹ֥ת שְׂמָלֹֽת׃

passages.text: And he sent to his father the following: ten donkeys loaded with the best of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provisions for his father’s journey.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the ruler over all the land of Egypt.
Joseph sent gifts to his father Jacob.
He sent ten donkeys.
These donkeys carried the best goods from Egypt.
He also sent ten female donkeys.
These female donkeys carried grain, bread, and food.
Joseph sent these things to provide for his father’s journey.
passages.original: וּלְאָבִ֞יו שָׁלַ֤ח כְּזֹאת֙ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה חֲמֹרִ֔ים נֹשְׂאִ֖ים מִטּ֣וּב מִצְרָ֑יִם וְעֶ֣שֶׂר אֲתֹנֹ֡ת נֹֽ֠שְׂאֹת בָּ֣ר וָלֶ֧חֶם וּמָז֛וֹן לְאָבִ֖יו לַדָּֽרֶךְ׃

passages.text: Then Joseph sent his brothers on their way, and as they were leaving, he said to them, “Do not quarrel on the way!”
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the ruler of Egypt.
Joseph spoke to his brothers.
Joseph sent his brothers away.
His brothers began their journey.
Joseph said to his brothers, "Do not quarrel on the way."
passages.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ אֶחָ֖יו וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַֽל־ תִּרְגְּז֖וּ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃

passages.text: So the brothers went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.
passages.sermon: Joseph’s brothers left Egypt.\r\nThey traveled to the land of Canaan.\r\nThey went to their father Jacob.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲל֖וּ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲבִיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: “Joseph is still alive,” they said, “and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt!” But Jacob was stunned, for he did not believe them.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the father of Joseph and his brothers.
Joseph’s brothers spoke to Jacob.
They said, “Joseph is still alive.”
They said, “Joseph rules over all the land of Egypt.”
Jacob was shocked.
Jacob did not believe his sons.
passages.original: וַיַּגִּ֨דוּ ל֜וֹ לֵאמֹ֗ר ע֚וֹד יוֹסֵ֣ף חַ֔י וְכִֽי־ ה֥וּא מֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיָּ֣פָג לִבּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י לֹא־ הֶאֱמִ֖ין לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: However, when they relayed all that Joseph had told them, and when he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him back, the spirit of their father Jacob was revived.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the father of the brothers.
The brothers spoke to Jacob.
They told Jacob everything Joseph had said to them.
Jacob saw the wagons.
Joseph had sent the wagons to carry Jacob back.
Jacob’s spirit revived.
passages.original: וַיְדַבְּר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו אֵ֣ת כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־ הָ֣עֲגָל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֥ח יוֹסֵ֖ף לָשֵׂ֣את אֹת֑וֹ וַתְּחִ֕י ר֖וּחַ יַעֲקֹ֥ב אֲבִיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: “Enough!” declared Israel. “My son Joseph is still alive! I will go to see him before I die.”
passages.sermon:
Israel was also called Jacob.
Israel spoke.
He said, “Enough!”
He said, “My son Joseph is still alive.”
He said, “I will go.”
He said, “I will see Joseph before I die.”
